product.name: Temporary Downpipe 150m Roll
product.description: The FloPlast Temporary Downpipe roll is available in a 150m roll or 6m lengths. Measures 150mm wide when laid flat, and a diameter of 90mm. product.description: The FloPlast Temporary Downpipe roll is available in a 150m roll or 6m lengths. Measures 150mm wide when laid flat, and a diameter of 90mm. The purpose of this product is to be used in an emergency drainage situation to redirect water from one location to another. It is compatible with all outlets and hoppers, due to being made of clear flexible plastic, it's lightweight design makes it extremely user friendly installation. To install the temporary downpipe roll, simply use a zip-tie or a jubilee clip.

product.name: Temporary Downpipe 150m Roll
product.description: The FloPlast Temporary Downpipe roll is available in a 150m roll or 6m lengths. Measures 150mm wide when laid flat, and a diameter of 90mm. The purpose of this product is to be used in an emergency drainage situation to redirect water from one location to another. It is compatible with all outlets and hoppers, due to being made of clear flexible plastic, it's lightweight design makes it extremely user friendly installation. To install the temporary downpipe roll, simply use a zip-tie or a jubilee clip.

The Stop End is self locking and has a built in EPDM rubber seal  the stop end does not require and sealant. As the Gutter profile is half round, the stop end is universal, meaning it can be used on both left hand and right hand.  For small component orders that do not include lengths. Please call our sales team on 01354 700853 to discuss delivery charge options.  As you will be aware, the ongoing situation in the Middle East is having a significant impact on global fuel costs. Lindab has informed us that they are no longer able to absorb these increases and have therefore introduced additional surcharges. Unfortunately, we are also unable to absorb these rising costs, although we anticipate that this will be a temporary issue. A25 surchargewill be applied to all orders over 500.  Please note: All orders between 0-1000 + vat containing 3mtr lengths of gutter or downpipe, will incur a 75.00 +VAT (90.00 inc vat) delivery charge.  All orders between 0-1000 + vat that contain fittings only will incur 55.00 +VAT. (66.00 inc vat)  For delivery to Northern Ireland, Scottish Highlands and other Offshore UK Addresses, please contact our sales team on 01354 700853 or by email at Sales@DrainageOnline.co.uk.  Drainage Online will be in contact after the order is processed to take the additional delivery charge.
